name: Spark 1.5% Cash Select

fx_fee.notes: No foreign transaction fees. Pay zero foreign transaction fees on purchases made outside of the United States.

credit_required.notes: Credit Level: Excellent. Spark Cash Select credit card holders typically have an excellent personal credit score.

base_rate.description: Earn unlimited 1.5% cash back for your business on every purchase, everywhere, no limits or category restrictions.

categories.label: 5% cash back on hotels and rental cars booked through Capital One Business Travel
